title_en: Yuhuatai District People's Procuratorate of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province v. Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao — case of disrupting production and business operations
ruling_gist_en: First, the defendant subjectively had the purposes of revenge and obtaining profit, and objectively, by maliciously purchasing a large number of other persons' goods or services on an online trading platform, caused the relevant entity to be identified by the online trading platform as engaging in false transactions and consequently subjected to control measures of search ranking demotion for goods, resulting in losses of more than RMB 100,000 to the relevant entity. Such conduct should be convicted and punished as the crime of disrupting production and business operations.
keywords_en: Criminal; Crime of disrupting production and business operations; Second instance trial; Intermediate people's court; Jiangsu Province; Anhui Province; Guangdong Province; Natural person; Criminal law; Constitutive elements of the crime of disrupting production and business operations; Characterization of reverse credit-brushing conduct; Determination of economic losses; Affirm the original judgment; Online trading platform; Malicious purchase; Search ranking demotion; Thesis plagiarism detection; Clarify the criminal law application of reverse credit-brushing conduct; Identify search ranking as a factor of production
full_text_en:
Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province v. Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao — case of sabotaging production and business operations

Ruling Summary

1. Where a defendant subjectively harbors the intent of retaliation and obtaining personal gain, and objectively causes losses of over RMB 100,000 to the aggrieved unit by maliciously purchasing large quantities of goods or services of others on an online trading platform, resulting in the aggrieved unit being identified as engaging in fraudulent transactions by the platform and being subjected to a search demotion control measure, such conduct shall be convicted and punished as the crime of sabotaging production and business operations.

2. The search ranking on an online trading platform constitutes an operational mode of the Internet economy and shall be recognized as a factor of production. For the purposes of criminal law interpretation, it may be construed by analogy with the credit standing or business reputation in the real economy. Reverse click farming both damages the counterparty's commercial reputation and sabotages production and business operations; where the two concur, the more serious offense shall be chosen for punishment.

3. The losses suffered by the aggrieved unit as a result of the defendant's criminal conduct may be comprehensively determined and assessed based on the industry development trend at the time of the incident, the aggrieved unit's daily income under normal circumstances, and its income during the incident, taking into account the principle of favoring the defendant.

Prosecuting Authority: Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Procuratorate.

Defendant: Dong Zhichao, male, 33 years old, Han ethnicity, self-employed, residing in Lujiang County, Hefei City, Anhui Province. Detained on suspicion of the crime of sabotaging production and business operations on May 17, 2014, and released on bail on June 23, 2014.

Defendant: Xie Wenhao, male, 22 years old, Han ethnicity, unemployed, domiciled in Shixing County, Guangdong Province. Detained on suspicion of the crime of sabotaging production and business operations on May 14, 2014, and released on bail on June 13, 2014.

The Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Procuratorate instituted a public prosecution against defendants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao for the crime of sabotaging production and business operations before the Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Court of Jiangsu Province.

The indictment alleged: In April 2014, defendant Dong Zhichao, for the purpose of gaining a competitive market advantage, employed defendant Xie Wenhao to use the same account multiple times to purchase large quantities of goods from the Taobao store of Beijing Zhichi Shuhui Technology Co., Ltd., Nanjing Branch (hereinafter referred to as "Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company"), causing the store to be identified by Taobao as engaging in fraudulent transactions for sales volume, and imposing a search demotion penalty on it. As consumers were unable to find the goods of Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's Taobao store via the Taobao search bar for several days, the company's normal operations were seriously affected. According to an audit, the economic loss suffered by Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company due to the search demotion affecting its operations amounted to RMB 159,844.29.

The prosecuting authority submitted that defendants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao, with the intent of undermining competitors, sabotaged production and business operations by other means, and their conduct violated Article 276 of the Criminal Law of the PRC and constituted a joint crime, and that they should be held criminally liable for the crime of sabotaging production and business operations.

Defendants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao did not dispute the facts of the crime as charged by the prosecuting authority.

Dong Zhichao's defense counsel argued: (1) The conduct of defendant Dong Zhichao did not constitute a crime; (2) Dong Zhichao's conduct was of a minor nature and had very little social harm; (3) The amount of loss to the aggrieved unit as determined by the audit was too high; (4) Dong Zhichao had a truthful confession and could be given a lighter punishment; (5) Dong Zhichao had a good character record, had no prior criminal record, was a first-time offender, confessed and repented after arrest, and had compensated the aggrieved unit for its economic losses, which could be considered for a lighter punishment.

The Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Court found the following facts at first instance:

In September 2013, Beijing Zhichi Shuhui Technology Co., Ltd. obtained the right to use Wanfang Data Knowledge Resource System V1.0 through Beijing Wanfang Data Co., Ltd. In November 2013, it registered an online store named "PaperPass Paper Passport" on Taobao, mainly engaged in paper similarity detection services (commonly known as "paper plagiarism check"), with its Nanjing branch, Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company, specifically responsible for operations.

In April 2014, defendant Dong Zhichao, who operated a paper similarity detection business on Taobao, for the purpose of gaining a competitive market advantage, employed and directed defendant Xie Wenhao to maliciously purchase large quantities of goods from Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's Taobao store multiple times using the same account. Specifically, in the early hours of April 18, he directed Xie Wenhao to use the same account to maliciously purchase 120 orders; in the early hours of April 22, he directed Xie Wenhao to use the same account to maliciously purchase 385 orders; and in the early hours of April 23, he directed Xie Wenhao to use the same account to maliciously purchase 1,000 orders.

On April 23, 2014, Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd. determined that Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's Taobao store had engaged in fraudulent transactions and imposed a penalty of product search demotion on the store. After an offline appeal by Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company, the search ranking of the store's products was restored on April 28. During the penalty period, consumers were unable to find the products of Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's Taobao store via the Taobao search bar for several days, seriously affecting the company's normal operations. According to an audit, the loss in order transaction value suffered by Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company due to the product search demotion penalty amounted to RMB 159,844.29.

It was also found that defendants Xie Wenhao and Dong Zhichao were arrested by the public security organs on May 13, 2014, and May 16, 2014, respectively, and both defendants truthfully confessed to their criminal facts after their arrest. During the investigation period, Dong Zhichao had compensated the aggrieved unit, Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company, for its economic losses in the amount of RMB 150,000.

The Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Court held at first instance:

Defendants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao, with the intent of undermining competitors, sabotaged production and business operations by other means, and their conduct constituted the crime of sabotaging production and business operations. Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao jointly and intentionally committed the criminal act of sabotaging production and business operations, constituting a joint crime. After their arrest, Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao truthfully confessed to their crimes, admitted guilt and repented in court, demonstrating a truthful confession, and were given a lighter punishment in accordance with the law. Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao were first-time offenders, had shown repentance by compensating the aggrieved unit for its economic losses, and both defendants' communities agreed to implement community corrections for them, so a suspended sentence could be imposed on them. In accordance with Article 276, Paragraph 1 of Article 25, Paragraph 3 of Article 67, Paragraph 1 of Article 72, and Paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 73 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, defendant Dong Zhichao was sentenced to one year and six months of imprisonment, suspended for two years, for the crime of sabotaging production and business operations; defendant Xie Wenhao was sentenced to one year of imprisonment, suspended for one year and two months, for the same crime.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao appealed to the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court.

Both Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao appealed on the grounds that their conduct was merely click farming and did not constitute the crime of sabotaging production and business operations.

The defense counsel for appellant Dong Zhichao also argued that Dong Zhichao did not constitute the crime of sabotaging production and business operations: (1) Dong Zhichao did not have the subjective intent of "retaliation and venting anger" required for the crime of sabotaging production and business operations; his conduct was merely a business practice of "undermining competitors"; his conduct did not constitute business conduct that destroys production materials, production tools, or machinery and equipment, and did not fall within "other methods of sabotaging production and business operations"; the consequences of the conduct did not render "production and business operations impossible"; and the factor of the demotion penalty imposed by Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd. intervened between the conduct and the consequences, so there was no causal relationship under criminal law. (2) The case had not reached the threshold for criminal filing for this crime. The expert opinion on the loss involved, based on the audit report, did not constitute an expert opinion but rather documentary evidence, and suffered from errors in material selection, confusion in reasoning, and a lack of corroboration from other evidence, and should not be admitted.

The procurator appearing in court argued that the first-instance judgment's conviction of appellants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao for the crime of sabotaging production and business operations was correct in nature, but in light of new evidence that emerged during the second-instance proceedings leading to a change in the amount of economic loss to the aggrieved unit as found by the first-instance judgment, he recommended that the second-instance court uphold the conviction of the first-instance judgment and impose a just sentence.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court found the following facts at second instance:

The Taobao platform is an online trading platform operated by Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd., including Taobao.com (taobao.com) and other domain names used by Taobao. To maintain the normal order of Taobao operations and protect the legitimate rights and interests of Taobao users, Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd. formulated the "Taobao Rules," which contain provisions that increase basic obligations or restrict basic rights of Taobao users. According to the Taobao Rules, to enhance the shopping experience of consumers, Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd. may impose market control measures such as product search demotion on Taobao for products that are suspected of obtaining sales volume through improper means, such as fraudulent transactions that harm buyers' rights and interests, i.e., adjusting the ranking of the product in search results.

In November 2013, Beijing Zhichi Shuhui Technology Co., Ltd. registered an online store named "PaperPass Paper Passport" on Taobao, mainly engaged in paper similarity detection services, with its Nanjing branch, Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company, specifically responsible for operations.

In April 2014, appellant Dong Zhichao, who operated a paper similarity detection business on Taobao, for the purpose of retaliation and obtaining personal gain, employed and directed appellant Xie Wenhao to maliciously purchase large quantities of goods from Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's Taobao store multiple times using the same account, intending to cause Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd. to impose market control measures such as search demotion on Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's products on suspicion of fraudulent transactions. Specifically, in the early hours of April 18, he directed Xie Wenhao to use the same account to maliciously purchase 120 orders; in the early hours of April 22, he directed Xie Wenhao to use the same account to maliciously purchase 385 orders; and in the early hours of April 23, he directed Xie Wenhao to use the same account to maliciously purchase 1,000 orders.

On April 23, 2014, Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd. determined that Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's Taobao store had engaged in fraudulent transactions and imposed a market control measure of product search demotion on the store's products. After an offline appeal by Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company, the search ranking of the store's products was restored on April 28 of the same year. During the search demotion period, consumers were unable to find the products of Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company's Taobao store via the Taobao search bar for several days, and the company's normal production and business operations at its Taobao store were disrupted. Upon analysis and statistics of the daily transaction amounts of Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company and industry transaction trends from April to May 2014, the loss suffered by Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company due to the search demotion of its products amounted to over RMB 100,000.

It was also found that appellants Xie Wenhao and Dong Zhichao were arrested by the public security organs on May 13, 2014, and May 16, 2014, respectively, and both appellants truthfully confessed to their criminal facts after their arrest. During the investigation period, Dong Zhichao had compensated the aggrieved unit, Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company, for its economic losses in the amount of RMB 150,000.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court held at second instance:

Appellants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao, for purposes of retaliation and other reasons, sabotaged production and business operations by other means, and their conduct constituted the crime of sabotaging production and business operations, and constituted a joint crime. Since new evidence emerged during the second-instance proceedings, the amount of loss caused by the two appellants as determined in the original judgment was erroneous and was hereby corrected. The sentences of the two appellants were adjusted in accordance with the law due to the change in the amount of loss. The opinion of the procurator appearing in court and the appeal ground of appellant Xie Wenhao that the sentence was too heavy were both reasonable and were adopted. After their arrest, Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao truthfully confessed to their crimes and could be given a lighter punishment in accordance with the law; they showed repentance by compensating the aggrieved unit for its losses, and a lighter punishment was given discretionarily. Based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of social harm of the two appellants' crimes, it was decided to give both appellants a lighter punishment and to impose a suspended sentence on Dong Zhichao.

Regarding the characterization of the two appellants' conduct. Upon review, the evidence on record confirmed that the two appellants subjectively had the intent of retaliation and obtaining personal gain, and objectively carried out conduct that sabotaged the aggrieved unit's production and business operations by damaging its commercial reputation. The aggrieved unit suffered losses of over RMB 100,000 as a result of the two appellants' conduct, and there was a causal relationship between the two appellants' conduct and the losses. Their conduct satisfied the constituent elements of the crime of sabotaging production and business operations and should be convicted and punished as such. The intervention of a third-party factor did not affect the determination of causation. Therefore, the relevant appeal grounds and defense arguments could not be established and were not adopted.

Regarding the determination of losses in this case. Upon review, the evidence on record confirmed that from April to May 2014, the number of web browsed searches and users for the paper similarity detection industry on Taobao was generally on the rise. During the period of the aggrieved unit's product search demotion, the daily confirmed receipt search-guided transaction amounts were only RMB 4,019, RMB 419, RMB 70, RMB 19, RMB 23, and RMB 4,932, with an average of RMB 1,578.8, far lower than the average amounts of RMB 18,547, RMB 23,352, and RMB 21,216 for April, May, or April to May of that year excluding the search demotion period. The losses were objectively present. In accordance with the principle of favoring the appellants, the court determined the loss at the lower end as over RMB 100,000. Therefore, the said defense argument could not be established and was not adopted.

Regarding the admissibility of relevant evidence presented by the defense counsel. At the second-instance trial, the defense counsel presented notarial certificates issued by the Lujiang County Notary Public Office of Anhui Province and relevant documentary evidence, proving that appellant Dong Zhichao purchased over 1,000 orders of a product named "Behavior Resulting from Comprehensive Testing of Large-Volume Purchases" from a relevant Taobao store on January 31, 2016, and that store was not penalized by the Taobao platform, thereby purporting to show that Dong Zhichao's conduct had no causal relationship under criminal law with the demotion of Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company, and that the Taobao platform's penalties were arbitrary and uncertain. In response, the procurator appearing in court presented an explanation issued by Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd., stating that with respect to Dong Zhichao's purchase of "Behavior Resulting from Comprehensive Testing of Large-Volume Purchases," Zhejiang Taobao Network Co., Ltd. determined that the product category was "postage." According to the company's rules, "postage links have no review entry and do not count toward sales," so they do not affect search ranking or traffic and cannot generate profit. The click-farmed products captured by the Taobao platform are normal products with reviews and sales, so purchasing such products in large quantities would not be captured by the relevant rules of the Taobao platform. Upon review, it was held that the conduct of Dong Zhichao in purchasing related products in bulk, as purportedly proven by this part of the evidence presented by the defense counsel, did not fall within the same category of purchasing goods or services as the conduct of purchasing goods of Zhichi Technology Nanjing Company in bulk in this case, and therefore was not relevant to the facts of this case and was not admissible.

Accordingly, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province, in accordance with Item (3) of Paragraph 1 of Article 225 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, Article 276, Paragraph 1 of Article 25, Paragraph 3 of Article 67, Paragraph 1 of Article 72, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 73, and Article 37 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, rendered judgment on December 19, 2016, as follows:

1. The conviction portion of the criminal judgment (2015) Yu Xing Er Chu Zi No. 29 of the Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Court against appellants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao is affirmed, i.e., appellant Dong Zhichao is guilty of the crime of sabotaging production and business operations, and appellant Xie Wenhao is guilty of the crime of sabotaging production and business operations.

2. The sentencing portion of the criminal judgment (2015) Yu Xing Er Chu Zi No. 29 of the Nanjing Yuhuatai District People's Court against appellants Dong Zhichao and Xie Wenhao is vacated, i.e., the sentence of one year and six months of imprisonment, suspended for two years, imposed on appellant Dong Zhichao, and the sentence of one year of imprisonment, suspended for one year and two months, imposed on appellant Xie Wenhao.

3. Appellant Dong Zhichao is convicted of the crime of sabotaging production and business operations and sentenced to one year of imprisonment, suspended for one year; appellant Xie Wenhao is convicted of the crime of sabotaging production and business operations and is exempted from criminal punishment.

This judgment is final.
